hook: Juliana enters the cathedral in a white bridal gown full of anticipation, only to be abruptly stopped and told Gerald is marrying someone else.
cliffhanger: Juliana is left gasping and devastated, realizing her fiancé is holding her sister's hand at the altar.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand the core conflict: a bride arriving at her wedding only to be betrayed.
narrative_context: The inciting incident of the series where Juliana's wedding is hijacked by her sister.
promotional_strength: High emotional stakes and a shocking betrayal immediately grab the viewer's attention.

evidence.observation: Juliana enters the church in a bridal gown.
The Lady in Gold Gown reveals she is marrying Gerald.

logline: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Symmetrical framing on the heavy church doors as they slowly part, pushing in slightly as Juliana stands framed in the light, dressed in an elegant white silk gown.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana pauses at the threshold, her expression bright with joyful anticipation, wearing her mother's vintage gown and an oval pendant necklace.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: High wide tracking shot following behind Juliana as she steps into the grand cathedral nave, facing the distant altar flanked by seated guests.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's face as her warm smile begins to falter into confusion.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana's eyes widen slightly in bewilderment as she notices something amiss at the altar.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile shot at the altar showing Gerald in his dark tailcoat holding the gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown, with Juliana visible walking down the distant aisle.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as Juliana stops midway down the aisle, confronted by a haughty matriarch in black velvet stepping into the foreground.

source_segments.label: MATRIARCH (Cold, Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
source_segments.text: You should turn around, Juliana.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Confused, Breathless)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Why?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Over-the-shoulder medium close-up past the Matriarch to Juliana, looking past her toward the altar.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Unbelieving)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Gerald is waiting for me.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.

source_segments.label: MATRIARCH (Blunt, Unforgiving)
source_segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
source_segments.text: Not anymore.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Pleading)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: What do you mean?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.

source_segments.label: MATRIARCH (Dismissive)
source_segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
source_segments.text: Look for yourself.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Panning shot across the seated wedding guests whispering and casting judging glances from the wooden pews.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Shaken, Whispering)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Gerald?

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Heartbroken)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Why are you holding her hand?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.

source_segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating, Smug)
source_segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
source_segments.text: Because he is marrying me.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Gasping, Devastated)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: No...
